workflowInput.requestedWork: Complete five-image same-prompt ensemble inversion with explicit local source binding, deterministic style-set hashing, and split held-out generation and ensemble judging. Infer only recurring visual language, retain the prior semantic-region and exact-text findings, keep all truth images analysis-and-judge-only, and use the still-unconsumed sealed bicycle-workshop test only after validation passes.
acceptanceCriteria: The canonical style-reference-set helper produces 805f0db0aec28aa2f7a74819d572c501a8a2406106de0f159b82ba929cabfc39 and review recomputes the same value.
The style model distinguishes five-image recurrence from per-image subject, wording, palette choice, pose, crop, objects, and concrete layout.
Every training, validation, and test judge record contains per-reference style losses for all five truth images and aggregates each style component by median.
Every image-edit tool call uses referenced_image_paths with exactly the resolved case source and omits num_last_images_to_include.
Every generation record carries a repository-relative provider_parameters.source_binding that matches input_images and declares recent_image_context_used false.
Every output is visually checked against its exact source before judging; an unrelated-source output routes directly to review without judge or refinement.
generate-validation-cases freezes and generates all held-out cases; validate-transferability independently judges them without regeneration or manifest access.
Every feedback item remains traceable and passes its semantic-region, typography, provenance, source-binding, hashing, or routing gate.
The final prompt is self-contained text, preserves arbitrary source identity and content, and requires no target or style-reference image at generation time.
Frozen validation and the sealed bicycle-workshop one-shot test prove baseline transfer, optional composition, exact-text adherence, and absence of unrequested text.
constraints: Use exact-path allowlisted reads only before validation; do not inventory target, validation, test, or prior-train directories.
Use repository-relative paths in persisted artifacts.
Use the built-in image generation tool with explicit referenced_image_paths binding only.
Treat train-0011 and feedback files as research evidence, not as unquestioned truth.
Do not modify prior iteration evidence or the existing truth manifest.
All five target/style truth images are analysis-and-judge-only and forbidden as generation inputs.
Do not open validationManifest before generate-validation-cases.
Do not open sealedTestManifest before audit-generalization.
Do not compare style-inversion-v3-ensemble-v1 losses numerically with singleton style-inversion-v3 or earlier versions, and do not update the singleton-regime best.json without recalibration.
